title: Hit probability
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph of degree $D$ on a vertex type $V$. For vertices $t,s\in V$ and an integer $k\ge 0$, the hit probability is the index-sampling probability that the predicate $G.\mathrm{hits}(t,s,w)=\mathrm{true}$ holds.
hypotheses_covered: A regular multigraph on V of natural-number degree D
Vertices t and s in V
caveat: The definition of the index-sampling probability and the meaning of G.hits are not included in the supplied definitions.
